# GrowthAudit

> Conversion audits, workflow repair, and AI agent setup for teams.

## Start Here

- [AI Agent Setup Help](https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/agent-setup.html): scoped 45-minute setup session.
- [AI Agent 配置帮助](https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/zh/agent-setup.html): Chinese service page.
- [Free Agent Setup Runbook](https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/agent-setup-runbook.html): copyable task, safety, verification, and stop rules.
- [免费 Agent 配置运行手册](https://newworldba.github.io/ai-growth-audit/zh/agent-setup-runbook.html): Chinese template.
